{{Top|leg}}
'''Second Administrator''' was the title given to the second in charge of the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]. In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], the position was held by two successive members of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], who infiltrated the mine organization as part of a takeover attempt. The first of these individuals was [[Torvon]]. After he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in his own assassination attempt on [[Chief Administrator/Legends|Chief Administrator]] [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]], he was replaced by [[Kymn]].
